latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release. Instantly edit and deliver videos remotely using AI.

- Upload raw video footage and specify editing instructions in plain language.
- Automated AI editing: trim silences, add captions, change aspect ratio, overlay text, or add background music.
- Exports polished 1080p MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes, ready to download.
- No manual timeline manipulation or export settings required.
- Supports major file types (mp4, mov, avi, webm, jpg, png, mp3, etc.), up to 500MB.
- Requires no local installation—video editing runs entirely on cloud GPUs.
